topic: A person's invention is already patented by someone else
text: I just found out that someone else has already patented my invention. All those late nights, the painstaking research, the countless prototypes, and it’s all for nothing. Of course, they managed to file it first. I should have known. Now, I’m stuck with this brilliant idea that’s as good as buried. I’ve poured everything into this, and now I’m supposed to just walk away? They beat me to it, but they didn’t invent it. They just filed the paperwork faster. Well, congratulations to them. I’m sure they’ll enjoy the profits of my sweat and tears.
